reviewer: Codex source review under maintainer instruction; not a human sign-off
review_method: Public repository opened in Codex web; pinned README, implementation and LICENSE retrieved from public raw URLs and inspected. No upstream code executed.
identity_check: Exact repository owner/name checked; same-name projects and legacy aliases not merged by name.
role_findings_zh: 查询与各档位说明进入 TypeSafe System One；Jev 返回档位概率，代码按阈值选择模型，并在接口错误时使用配置的回退项。
role_findings_en: The query and tier descriptions enter TypeSafe System One. Jev returns tier probabilities; code applies thresholds and a configured fallback on API failure.
limitations_zh: “最便宜且胜任”是作者的目标，本库未验证实际成本或任务质量。返回的是路由结果，不代表下游模型已执行任务。
limitations_en: The cheapest-capable-model framing is the author’s goal, not a verified cost or quality result. A route response does not mean the downstream model executed the task.

sources.inspected_scope: Project overview, Jev role, installation entry and limitations; full file captured, not every unrelated feature audited.
